description: This file manages embedding providers, including creation, fallback logic, and integration with various external embedding services and local models. It handles configuration, error handling, and dynamic provider selection.

methods.name: createLocalEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Creates a local embedding provider using the node-llama-cpp library, supporting model loading and embedding context management.

methods.name: createEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Main function to create an embedding provider based on configuration, handling auto-selection, fallback, and error management.

methods.name: isNodeLlamaCppMissing
methods.description: Checks if an error is due to missing node-llama-cpp dependency.

methods.name: formatLocalSetupError
methods.description: Formats error messages related to local embedding setup issues, including missing dependencies.
